rationale_overall: Single-slot watchlist (cap=1) holds NVDA. Its Aug 28 Q2 FY25 print showed record revenue $30.0B (+122% YoY), data-center $26.3B (+154% YoY), and ~$32.5B Q3 guidance — the AI buildout still accelerating. The Aug 5 selloff (NVDA -9.5%) was a liquidity-driven vol spike, not a fundamentals break, reaffirmed by earnings weeks later. The Sep 20 Microsoft-Constellation Three Mile Island PPA validates nuclear-for-AI-datacenters but is a supply-side adjacency, not a stronger sole AI exposure than NVDA; at cap=1 a swap would trade the demand-side leader for an adjacency. Hold NVDA.
